additional_info.subject: RE: ID0478638-DC/Si-D/TR- [MP/S4 170003524] Charging Session Issue CRM:00472000565
additional_info.body:
Hi Joao,
This case is not related to the firmware. The charger has had an ongoing issue for quite some time. We have opened multiple tickets for this problem, but the L2 team has closed them stating that the issue was resolved on its own.
In the attached table, I highlighted the charging sessions on outlets 3 and 4 in yellow. As you can see, the charging sessions consistently stop after 4–5 minutes, and the charging process does not continue afterwards.
The L2 team previously indicated that there might be an issue with BT5, so we replaced it, but the problem persisted. We have also replaced IMDBC3, IMDBC4, and KF213, however the issue is still ongoing.
At this point, we would appreciate a detailed investigation and a clear solution, as we have not been able to identify any clear indication from the log records.
With best regards,
Yunus Emre Temel

additional_info.subject: Solve Description
additional_info.body:
Three on-site service interventions were performed due to an ongoing issue.
1st Intervention:
BT5 was replaced per L2 guidance; issue not resolved.
2nd Intervention:
IMDBC3 and IMDBC4 were replaced; all cabling checked, but issue persisted.
3rd Intervention & Findings:
When DC4 (+/-) was disconnected, DC3 charged continuously; when DC3 (+/-) was disconnected, DC4 charged continuously. With both connected, sessions on DC3/DC4 stopped within 5 minutes with Bender E05 fault. While charging on DC1, 2–3 V was measured at QA23–24, while QA19–20 remained at mV level.
Root Cause:
Incorrect wiring of WC20 and WC29 on busbars (reversed during factory assembly).
Action:
Wiring corrected. Device operates normally and issue is resolved.
